name: purchase-request-lifecycle
description: Creates a purchase request and validates save and initial workflow state

doc_metadata.title: Purchase Request List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Purchase Request list page. Purchase requests initiate the procurement workflow for materials, spare parts, and services.

doc_metadata.title: Create New Purchase Request
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a new purchase request. Fill in the required fields such as description and requested items.

steps.value: E2E Test — Spare parts for pump maintenance

doc_metadata.title: Fill Form Field
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Test — Spare parts for pump maintena" into the Pr Description field.

doc_metadata.title: Save Purchase Request
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Save' to create the purchase request. It will start in Draft state and can be submitted for approval.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Capture the success notification and the workflow state badge.

doc_metadata.title: Purchase Request Details
doc_metadata.caption: The purchase request is now saved. Use the workflow dropdown to submit it for approval.
